turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
Tracking sometimes does not update right away, so once you receive the tracking email, please allow 1 to 3 business days for the carrier to start showing movement.

If there is still no update after that, the best next step is to keep checking the tracking for a little longer, since some orders take additional time to be picked up and scanned. If you still have not received a tracking number after 10 business days, please check your spam folder first.
